This query forms part of a series of SHEBANQ queries investigating the Hakhel audience formula in Deuteronomy 31:12, with particular attention to טף (“little ones”).

This query searches for co-occurrence of טף with all named members of the Deut 31:12 group: men, women, or resident aliens.

**Observations**

There is only one instance where all four named members of the Deut 31:12 group are mentioned in the same verse.

queries.query_name: Deut 31:12 audience without the טף ('litle ones')
queries.public_description:
The query is part of a series of SHEBANQ queries investigating the Hakhel audience formula in Deuteronomy 31:12, with a special focus on the טף ('little ones') therein.

This SHEBANQ query searches any co-occurrences where טף is excluded, while the other members from Deut 31:12 are present: men, women, and resident alien.

**Building the query**

Relevant terms:

  - the small ones:   VP/ 
  - man: >JC/
  - woman: >CH/
  - resident alien: GR/

EMDROS does not allow combining NOTEXIST  with UNORDEREDGROUP. Therefore it it required to explicitly write out all possible ordered sequences of men, women and resident alien. With 3 variables, there are 3!=6 possible orderings. 

**Observations**

The query will not return a verse. This is correct, since the combination of man, woman and resident alien (in one verse) is not found 'stand-alone,' but only in combination with the 'little ones'. 

The correctness of the query can be checked by commenting out *all* of the NOTEXIST statements which will return Deut 31:12 as the only result.

**All queries in this group**

  - [All occurrences of טף](/hebrew/text?iid=7334&page=1&mr=r&qw=q)
  - [Co-occurrences of טף with any of Deut 31:12 group](/hebrew/text?iid=7333&page=1&mr=r&qw=q)
  - [Co-occurrences of טף with all members of Deut 31:12 group](/hebrew/text?iid=7328&page=1&mr=r&qw=q)
  - [Deut 31:12 audience without the טף ('little ones')](/hebrew/text?iid=7329&page=1&mr=r&qw=q)
queries.author: Tony Jurg
queries.project: ReMa Digital Humanities and Biblical Studies
queries.mql:
SELECT ALL OBJECTS WHERE

[VERSE 
  NOTEXIST [WORD lex = "VP/"]
  // 1st permutation 
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">JC/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">CH/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = "GR/"]

OR

  NOTEXIST [WORD lex = "VP/"]
  // 2nd permutation 
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">JC/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = "GR/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">CH/"]

OR

  NOTEXIST [WORD lex = "VP/"]
  // 3rd permutation 
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">CH/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">JC/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = "GR/"]

OR

  NOTEXIST [WORD lex = "VP/"]
  // 4th permutation 
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">CH/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = "GR/"]
  ..
  [WORD lex = ">JC/"]

OR

  NOTEXIST [WORD lex = "VP/"]
  // 5th permutation 
  [WORD FOCUS lex = "GR/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">JC/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">CH/"]

OR

  NOTEXIST [WORD lex = "VP/"]
  // 6th permutation 
  [WORD FOCUS lex = "GR/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">CH/"]
  ..
  [WORD FOCUS lex = ">JC/"]
]

GO

queries.local_description: Control query for verses in which טף occurs with גר in a verse.
queries.query_name: Where occur טף and גר together
queries.public_description:
The query is part of a series of SHEBANQ queries investigating the Hakhel audience formula in Deuteronomy 31:12, with a special focus on the טף ('litle ones') therein.

This SHEBANQ query searches any cooccurance where טף and גר occur together.
queries.author: Tony Jurg
queries.project: ReMa Digital Humanities and Biblical Studies
queries.mql:
SELECT ALL OBJECTS WHERE
[verse 
  [UNORDEREDGROUP
    [word FOCUS lex = "VP/"]
    [word FOCUS lex = "GR/"]
  ]
]
